fields.summary_ko.0: Greg Abel became CEO of Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA, BRKB) in place of Warren Buffett, with the stock up approximately 9% for the year.
fields.summary_ko.1: Berkshire has recently expanded its Alphabet stake and increased technology stock investments such as Bending Spoons, showing a trend of increasing portfolio risk.
fields.summary_ko.2: Abel may show greater preference for technology stocks than Buffett, so long-term investors should monitor the company's future direction.
